title: Abandoned Alchemy Lab
description: A dusty, derelict laboratory features a large rectangular sandbox table covered in intricate patterns and circular tracks. A brass microscope, an open book with diagrams, scattered pills, and broken tools rest on the surface while glass jars line the back shelves. Overhead, complex glass tubing and wires hang from the ceiling, with fine particles drifting through beams of light in a forgotten concrete room.
